author: @bitgamma

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. The change is a single JSON version field update in src/cpp/resources/backend_versions.json. Users who previously used any Kokoro voice will now get b21 instead of b17, which is a drop-in replacement — no API, CLI, config format, or behavior changes in Lemonade's contract.
evidence.documentation: No documentation changes needed. This is a version bump for a bug fix; no user-facing behavior, CLI, API, or config changes. Issue #3682 documents the original problem, and the PR body links to it.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No manual release testing is required. This is a version bump in a JSON version pin file only; no code paths, CLI commands, API endpoints, GUI elements, or config options are touched. The Kokoro backend itself is unchanged — only the pinned tag for its CPU and Metal build artifacts moves from b17 to b21. Residual risk: b21 contains fixes for 5 specific voices but no release notes from Kokoro are available to confirm the full scope of changes.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The PR contains exactly one commit (fde55d06) which was the original commit before approval. No commits were added after @superm1's approval.
evidence.review: PR #3695 was approved by @superm1 on 2026-09-29T14:56:36Z, submitted before merge. No inline review comments were left. The PR body is well-structured, self-reviewed by the author, and clearly states it fixes #3682. @bitgamma has subject area expertise in 'new backends' per docs/dev/contribute.md, which includes Kokoro.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change only modifies a version pin in a JSON resource file. No supply-chain changes, credential handling, network calls, code execution, or permission changes beyond updating which pre-built artifact tag is downloaded.
evidence.tests: No new tests were added, which is appropriate for a version bump in a JSON config file. The fix is validated indirectly through the PR's linked issue #3682 which demonstrates the bug with concrete curl/ffprobe evidence. The PR author reported local testing.

subject: bump Kokoro version (#3695)
summary: Bumps the Kokoro TTS backend version from b17 to b21 on both CPU and Metal, fixing four British English voices (bf_emma, bf_isabella, bm_george, bm_lewis) and one French voice (ff_siwis) that returned ~0.3s of fixed-length audio regardless of input text.
verdict_reason: Single-file version bump with a clear bug fix, approved by a maintainer, all CI passing, and no post-approval changes.
